title: Contracts Lead
minimumQualification: Qualifications (You Must Have) Indian law graduate with an LL.B degree. Company Secretarial qualification (ACS/FCS) will be an added advantage. At least 10 to 12 plus years of relevant experience in contract drafting, negotiation, and management with a major law firm and/or corporation. Strong multinational commercial transactional experience across a range of commercial agreements. Contracting experience in the Oil and Gas or industrial automation industry will be an added advantage. Demonstrable record of acting as a business partner, providing advice that blends legal experience with a genuine understanding of and appreciation for the client's business objectives, and the ability to understand and support the business effectively. Excellent communication and strong negotiation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and to work under pressure against tight timelines, including extended hours when required. We Value Ability to analyze and interpret terms and conditions. Strong intellectual capacity and high personal standards of excellence. Personal presence, communication skills, and credibility necessary to effectively interact with and influence senior stakeholders. Integrity and good judgment. Ability to set priorities and work independently, driving key initiatives with limited direct supervision. Ability to work with team members and suppliers across different locations and functions. Attention to detail and a drive for efficiencies and process improvements. Solid analytical skills and strong business acumen. Demonstrated ability to deliver on complex situations and to consistently make timely decisions balancing available information. Ability to convey information with clarity and directness. Strong organization and project management skills. Interest and ability to advise and motivate the business on contractual issues affecting commercial transactions. Self-motivated, dedicated team player who takes a proactive approach to continuously improving the internal contracting function. Willingness to travel approximately 20% of the time.
jobDescription: The Contract Manager, PA supports the businesses of Process Automation (PA) and the Industrial Automation (IA) Strategic Business Unit in India, and reports into the General Counsel – HAIL, IA & PA for India. This role will be partnering with sales, commercial, and functional teams to enable growth, execute deals, and drive contracting excellence across the region. The role encompasses all facets of contract formation and contract management, including drafting, interpretation, negotiation, review, and administration of complex customer agreements. The Contract Manager ensures that final contractual documents reflect all deal parameters approved under the applicable approval processes and that business is conducted in accordance with the highest ethical standards, internal company policies, and local and international laws. Through effective management and oversight of contract execution, this role helps ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, mitigates risk, and protects the Company's commercial interests across the region. As a Contracts Lead at Honeywell, you will be responsible for managing and overseeing the contract lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders, and ensuring successful contract execution while mitigating legal risks. Key Responsibilities Serve as a senior point of contact in PA and IA (India) for commercial contracting matters, partnering with the legal team and business leadership to deliver timely contract support across the region. Draft, review, negotiate, interpret, and administer legal documentation for a broad range of commercial transactions, including customer sale agreements, supply agreements, distribution agreements, licensing agreements, joint development agreements, and other related business agreements. Manage the regional PA and IA contract review function in alignment with established contracting processes, baseline terms, and practices; identify and mitigate risks connected with non-standard conditions; advise internal clients on legal and contractual requirements. Provide independent contract evaluation and guidance to internal stakeholders regarding their contractual rights and obligations. Analyze and advise on contractual and related legal issues arising in commercial transactions and project execution, including commercial law, intellectual property, licensing, and risk/opportunity analysis; provide legal advisory services to management and the business. Manage litigation and dispute resolution for the region, including project-related disputes, customer and vendor claim management, and project delay analysis; develop and direct dispute-resolution strategy, coordinate with external counsel, and escalate significant matters to senior counsel as appropriate. Support corporate compliance in the contracting process, covering competition law, anti-bribery regimes (FCPA, Prevention of Corruption Act), and IP protection. Ensure that agreements and purchase orders executed by the Company comply with the Honeywell Code of Business Conduct, the applicable approvals matrix, SEA, and other internal company policies. Conduct preventive-law and contracting training for the business on a range of topics, including competition law compliance, contracting excellence, protection of intellectual property, the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, the Prevention of Corruption Act, and workplace issues and policies; train internal stakeholders on key contractual clauses, the Honeywell Code of Business Conduct, and the use of and compliance with established contracting processes. Lead development and maintenance of standardized processes, templates, and clause libraries for efficient contracting services. Track and manage contractual obligations, approvals, renewals, and expirations; maintain accurate contract records and repositories. Guide and mentor junior contracting staff, sharing best practices and supporting continuous improvement of the contracting function. At least 10 to 12 plus years of relevant experience in contract drafting, negotiation, and management with a major law firm and/or corporation. Strong multinational commercial transactional experience across a range of commercial agreements. Manage litigation and dispute resolution for the region, including project-related disputes, customer and vendor claim management, and project delay analysis; develop and direct dispute-resolution strategy, coordinate with external counsel, and escalate significant matters to senior counsel as appropriate. Support corporate compliance in the contracting process, covering competition law, anti-bribery regimes (FCPA, Prevention of Corruption Act), and IP protection. Ensure that agreements and purchase orders executed by the Company comply with the Honeywell Code of Business Conduct, the applicable approvals matrix, SEA, and other internal company policies. Personal presence, communication skills, and credibility necessary to effectively interact with and influence senior stakeholders. Integrity and good judgment. jobDescription: As a Senior Finance Analyst at GBS BFS, you will be instrumental in managing P&L at the regional/Strategic Business Unit (SBU) /Line of business (LOB) level. Your responsibilities will encompass analysis and operational oversight, providing financial insights to support strategic decision-making and enhance business performance. Core duties include regular financial performance monitoring, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Additionally, the role involves operational tasks such as accruals and financial reporting. Key Responsibilities Periodic Financial Analysis and Metrics Management: Drive performance to meet targets for pricing, orders, revenue, Variable Contribution Margin (VCM), fixed costs, free cash flow (FCF), and conversion. Identify opportunities for improvement in these areas. Collaboration with Functional Leaders: Work closely with functional leaders to support activities such as Pulse, SRO (Short Range Outlook), AOP (Annual Operating Plan), and related forecasting processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial projections. Lead and participate in monthly sessions with both operations and finance leadership to review R&O (risks and opportunities), financial performance, address variances, and align action plans. Insight Generation and Financial Analysis: Provide new and valuable insights through comprehensive financial analysis, supporting informed decision-making and strategic initiatives. Standardization and Automation Initiatives: Promote and implement the standardization and automation of financial processes and report to drive productivity and operational efficiency across the team. Oversee the timely and accurate completion of recurring deliverables, including accruals, intercompany recharges, and the preparation of financial reports. Prepare leadership presentations and support monthly operating reviews. minimumQualification: Basic Qualifications & Skills University Degree in Science or Engineering only. HSE qualification: Diploma in Industrial Safety from a recognized institute . Strong influencing skills with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. Ability to quickly build client-customer relationships in a challenging and changing environment.
jobDescription: As a Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineer, you will serve as a key point of support and contact for the District HSE Leader. Your role involves delivering the Business Area (BA) HSE Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for the region, with dedicated support for the Service Line of Business (LOB). You will ensure compliance, drive continuous improvement, and strengthen the safety culture across operations. Additionally, you will manage the overall HSE Management System (HSEMS) for the district. As an HSE Engineer I here at Honeywell, you will foster a culture of safety, health, and environmental responsibility, ensuring compliance and promoting sustainability. Manage budgets and collaborate to mitigate hazards. Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental standards during field operations, supporting safe execution of Service contracts and promoting a strong safety culture on-site. Implement and monitor HSE policies, procedures, and standards at the field level. Conduct regular site inspections and audits to identify hazards and ensure corrective actions. Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions; prepare reports and recommend preventive measures. Maintain accurate HSE permits and other documentation. Support risk assessments and Job Safety Analysis (JSA) for critical activities. Coordinate emergency preparedness drills and ensure readiness of safety equipment. Assist in driving a continuous improvement culture within HSE. Additional Responsibilities (New Points): HSE Training & Competency Development: Deliver HSE training sessions (onsite and virtual), conduct induction and orientation programs for new employees, and review/implement Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to ensure competency development for field and service teams. Regional PPE Logistics Management: Manage regional PPE logistics for the Service LOB, ensuring timely availability and compliance with standards. Regional Contract MOS Review: Regularly review and update the regional contract Management Operating System (MOS) to align with HSE standards and Service LOB requirements. Data Analysis and Digital Tool Support: Provide data analysis and support the use of digital tools for HSE performance tracking, reporting, and continuous improvement. Contractor HSE Performance Monitoring: Monitor and audit contractor HSE performance against key HSE parameters, ensuring compliance and driving continuous improvement for Service LOB. Key Deliverables Achieve or exceed the annual operating plan (AOP) by reducing and eliminating incidents. Sustain and improve HSE maturity, observations, corrective action metrics, and other general KPIs. Ensure compliance with all HSE standards from leadership, employees, contractors, and subcontractors. Foster a continuous improvement culture for HSE within the region. (HTS) Location: Bangalore, KA Key

- out-sourcing of services and works, non-disclosure agreements, consultancy agreements, etc. Enable right and fast legal counsel on full range of legal and regulatory issues for SBG’s and Functions of HTS in the region , including those relating to corporate, commercial and contract law, environmental, health and safety, intellectual property, leasing licensing, compliance, foreign transactions, labour and employment, liability, anti-trust, etc. Closely work with business and functions to resolve procurement related processes and compliance, HR and Labor laws including POSH, Labor Code, capable to advise on diverse queries and also support internal investigations, PIPs etc. , SEZ / EOUs related complexities and capable to suggest on various modelling to suit HON requirement from time to time, basic knowledge on export import process, capable to handle Police and investigation by various agencies and ability to handle on-ground matters, fair understanding of financial and tax laws including FDI, Transfer Pricing, FX matters, environmental, real estate, operations /facilities, CSR matters Manage litigation and direct dispute resolution efforts, including the management of external counsels for referred matters in the region. jobDescription:
As an Estimator I here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for supporting the development of project estimates and ensuring their accuracy and competitiveness. This position plays a crucial role in assisting the organization's growth and profitability by providing support in cost analysis, bid strategy, and risk assessment. Domain: Marine Platforms Prepare and delivery of high-quality responses to customer requests for proposals (RFPs), estimates, and information, with a specific focus for both global and domestic markets. Ensuring alignment with sales and operations goals across (Field/Migrations/Upgrades) segments for global and India domestic business. Deliver Accurate, professional proposals that exceed customer expectations, and continuously innovate to enhance the proposal development process. Efficiently leverage advanced systems, tools, and methodologies to manage estimates, proposals, customer requests, responses, and supporting documentation with accuracy and transparency. Maintain a strong track record of proposal success through the application of experience, strategic insights, and effective use of available resources. Ensuring timely delivery of high-quality proposals and estimates while promoting collaboration and excellence As an Estimator I here at Honeywell, you will support the development of project estimates, ensuring their accuracy and competitiveness. You will assist in cost analysis, bid strategy, and risk assessment. Proposals and estimates are captured within CPQ, as per the Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). Complete cost estimates and proposals within the required time. Accurate portrayal of costs in the form of cost estimates. Propose technical and / or commercial alternatives that enable the lowest compliant bid while providing the highest value to the customer. Adhere to the Standard Operating Procedures. Study RFQ and other documents / drawings supplied by customers and propose or seek a consultant led solution which fits technical & commercial requirements. Identify 3rd party Packages and engage Procurement to obtain sub-vendors Technical and Commercial offers. jobDescription:
As an Advanced Systems Engineer here at Honeywell, you will design, implement, and manage complex systems, driving innovation, safety, and efficiency. work schedule. Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) of Project Manager
1. Project Planning & Scheduling Develop comprehensive project execution plans defining project scope, deliverables, milestones, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements. Establish project objectives and align all stakeholders with project goals and timelines. Create and maintain project schedules to ensure activities are executed in accordance with contractual commitments. Identify project dependencies, constraints, and potential risks impacting project execution. Develop mitigation plans to minimize schedule, commercial, and operational risks. Coordinate project priorities across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, quality, and customer teams. Ensure effective planning and resource allocation throughout the project lifecycle.
2. Project Execution & Monitoring Lead and coordinate project execution from customers kick-off through project completion. Monitor project performance against approved scope, budget, schedule, and quality objectives. Track engineering progress, material readiness, manufacturing schedules, inspections, documentation, and shipment activities. Identify project issues proactively and implement corrective actions to maintain project objectives. Drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure on-time project delivery. Conduct regular project review meetings and provide project status updates to management and customers. Ensure project milestones are achieved in accordance with contractual requirements.
3. Stakeholder & Customer Management Act as the primary customer interface during project execution. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships to ensure high customer satisfaction. Lead customer kick-off meetings, progress review meetings, and project status discussions. Coordinate with customers, vendors, factories, logistics providers, consultants, EPC contractors, and internal teams. Manage customer expectations and resolve project-related concerns in a timely manner. Facilitate communication between stakeholders to ensure alignment on project objectives and deliverables. Support conflict resolution and escalation management when required.
4. Commercial & Contract Management Ensure project execution complies with contractual obligations and commercial commitments. Monitor project financial performance, revenue realization, and profitability. Manage project scope changes, variation orders, and contractual deviations. Evaluate commercial impacts arising from customer revisions and change requests. Review project commitments and ensure alignment between project scope and contractual requirements. Support risk assessment and commercial decision-making throughout project execution. Ensure achievement of project financial objectives and business targets.
5. Vendor, Factory & Supply Chain Coordination Coordinate with Honeywell factories, third-party vendors, and supply chain teams to ensure timely project execution. Monitor material readiness and manufacturing progress. Follow up on critical deliveries and mitigate supply chain risks. Escalate manufacturing, procurement, and logistics issues that may impact project schedules. Coordinate with vendors and factories to achieve committed delivery dates. Support inspection readiness, shipment planning, and material dispatch activities. 6 . Inspection, FAT & Delivery Management Lead planning and coordination of Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), inspections, and customer witness activities. Coordinate with customers, third-party inspectors, vendors, factories, and quality teams. Monitor inspection schedules and ensure timely closure of open actions. Review inspection status and project readiness before shipment. Ensure successful completion of project delivery milestones. Support logistics and shipment coordination to meet customer delivery requirements.
7. Risk, Quality & Compliance Management Identify, assess, and manage project risks throughout the project lifecycle. Maintain project risk registers and mitigation plans. Ensure compliance with customer specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable industry standards. Promote a proactive approach toward quality, safety, and risk management. Monitor project performance and implement preventive actions where necessary. Drive issue resolution and escalation management to minimize project impact.
8. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams involved in project execution. Provide direction and support to Project Engineers, Engineering Teams, Procurement Teams, Quality Teams, Logistics Teams, and Vendors. Foster collaboration and accountability among stakeholders. Support effective decision-making and prioritization of project activities. Promote a culture of teamwork, ownership, and continuous improvement. Drive alignment between business objectives and project execution activities.
9. Closing & Project Handover Ensure all contractual, technical, commercial, and documentation requirements are completed prior to project closure. Obtain formal customer acceptance and project signoffs. Verify completion of all project deliverables and outstanding obligations. Coordinate project handover to service, operations, or post-order support teams as applicable. Capture and document lessons learned from project execution. Archive project records and ensure proper documentation retention. Share project learnings and best practices with Engineering and Project Execution teams. Formally close projects in accordance with organizational procedures. jobDescription:
This position will lead the Finance activities for Project & Automation Solutions (“PAS”) Line of Business for India. This role will partner and support in driving financial performance, managing and standardizing key business processes including the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Monthly Business Review (MBR), Financial Analysis and Forecasts and drive results, including working capital reduction via our matrix organisation. This role will also participate in project and productivity reviews and is responsible for ensuring project review compliance. Business Partnering: Provides business partnering to India PAS General Manager & cross functional team to drive Growth and ensure to deliver on the financial commitments
- Revenue, Operating Income, Working Capital, Cash Flow. Provide financial guidance to PAS India team for all activities of the business including Strategic analysis, Specific Deal Analysis, Deal Modeling, Contract Reviews and Cost Control. Provides strong finance leadership in CPQs and all commercial and credit decisions during budgetary and firm proposals. Financial Planning & Analysis: Leads the AOP planning process for the LOB and support Monthly Business Review. Analyze & interpret key financials including profitability, project backlog, backlog margin, deviations, utilization, billability and recovery. Be an active influencer and change agent for the sales, inventory operations planning (SIOP) process. Ensure Intense focus on cost productivity and financial discipline through the development of detailed and prudent business plans, the deployment of spend analysis tools, and influence / inspection/validation of these programs Customer to Cash (C2C): Monitors & reviews Working Capital for the LOB and partners with the Working Capital team to improve turns, minimize bad debts & support Working Capital improvement initiatives as required to drive C2C efficiency. Internal Controls and Compliance: Ensures strong internal controls are in place, project reviews are adhered, and any project cost overruns are identified early. Perform a formal (documented) quarterly analytic review of the P&L and balance sheet for the LOB , investigating and documenting all unusual trends and fluctuations. Other: Work with other members of the Finance Team and maintain a productive, dynamic and rewarding team environment. Take some common activities at PA India level & work on few adhoc projects at PA India level. Leading process improvement initiatives. Qualification and Technical Abilities: Professionally (CA ) qualified more than 8-10 years of experience in finance and accounting. Experience in Manufacturing, project & Service Industry is desirable Comfortable and experienced at dealing with various functions and global stakeholders. Fluent in verbal English and in written communication. Knowledge of ERP systems, Preferable SAP . Excellent in MS Office tools . Good knowledge of US GAAP , Direct /Indirect Taxes
- Well versed with Project Accounting Skills Persuasive and articulate, able to influence and negotiate with Cross Functional Team . Experience in all aspects of the engineering development life cycle, and program management including key Agile tools and techniques such as scrum, Kanban, sprints, epics, and story point estimating. Advanced Degree (MBA, Engr). Scaled Agile Framework – SAFe Certification. PMP, Agile Certification (scrum master PSM, CSM) or equivalent certification preferred. jobDescription:
Be part of the Program Management Office (PMO) that is integral to our Honeywell Connected Enterprise (HCE) portfolio with responsibility over Engineering Operations across all our global sites determining Management Operating Systems (MOS) and implementing best practices for elements such as: Strategic Planning (STRAP), Annual Operating Plans (AOP), life cycle management, metrics, scrum, and agile techniques that supports the development and integration of highly complex software functions within HCE. You will partner with world class engineering and leaders to implement product strategies, develop program schedules and milestones, and define technology. You will also generate innovative solutions in work situations; trying different and novel ways to deal with problems and opportunities. The Senior Advanced Project Engineer will assist in creating and executing on Connected Enterprise engineering management operating system, manage projects as required, and contribute to strategy deployment of Connected Enterprise business. This position will provide support for a variety of products, processes, and system development programs across customer platforms. You will be responsible for programs including technical, financial, and organizational elements. You will work in close coordination with the PMO, technical managers, software engineers as well as support functions. You will be responsible for close interaction and support of strategic business initiatives including proposal development, strategic planning and customer support and product development. You will achieve breakthrough improvements in program performance through development and deployment of cost effective and proactive processes. As a Sr Advanced Project Engr here at Honeywell, you will lead a team of engineers, ensuring successful project execution and high-quality solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet engineering support requirements. You will report directly to our Manager and you’ll work out of our Bengaluru, Karnataka location on a Hybrid work schedule. Essential

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Generate and implement MOS, programs and other requirements using SAFe and CCMI techniques; Understand and support both the Support strategic planning (STRAP) and annual operation plan (AOP) and are comfortable assisting in formally establishing these processes Understands the SW development life cycle, both waterfall and agile. jobDescription: Location: Hyderabad Function: Engineering / Platform & Data Infrastructure About the Role We are looking for a highly experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep expertise in Mongo DB, Postgre SQL, and Elasticsearch to own and support mission-critical database platforms serving enterprise Saa S applications. This role is not suitable for candidates with only development or basic DBA experience. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience designing, operating, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale production environments containing millions of records, supporting 24x7 high-availability systems with strict uptime SLAs. The engineer will independently diagnose complex database failures, perform failovers, optimize performance under load, ensure business continuity, influence technical direction, and mentor junior engineers. As an Advanced Software Engineer here at Honeywell, you will lead advanced software development projects, enhance and maintain critical software components, and troubleshoot complex issues. Your expertise will optimize software performance and drive innovation. Database Design & Architecture Architect and implement scalable, high-availability Mongo DB solutions including replica sets, sharded clusters, Atlas deployments, and disaster recovery architectures. Design, implement, and manage Mongo DB, Postgre SQL, and Elasticsearch environments across development, staging, and production. Define schema design standards, sharding strategies, indexing approaches, data lifecycle management, and capacity planning. Production Reliability & Operations Own 24x7 production database operations with accountability for uptime, reliability, and SLA compliance. Diagnose and resolve complex database incidents, execute failovers, recovery activities, root-cause analysis, and business continuity procedures. Lead rolling upgrades, patching, migrations, and maintenance with minimal or zero downtime. Performance & Optimization Analyze query patterns, design optimal indexes, tune aggregation pipelines, and eliminate bottlenecks. Monitor performance metrics and drive continuous improvements using profiler, explain plans, Atlas tools, and observability platforms. Optimize high-volume databases containing millions of records and heavy workloads. Security & Reliability Implement RBAC, TLS/SSL, encryption, LDAP integration, auditing, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies. Ensure enterprise-grade database security, resilience, and operational governance. Leadership & Collaboration Define database best practices, review data models, and provide technical leadership. Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with development, platform, SRE, and Dev Ops teams. Deep expertise in replica sets, sharding, Atlas, replication, failover, query tuning, and aggregation framework. Strong Postgre SQL and Elasticsearch administration and performance tuning experience. Experience managing databases supporting enterprise Saa S applications and millions of records. Cloud experience on Azure , AWS, or GCP and strong Linux administration skills. Programming experience in .NET, Java, Python, Java Script/Node.js, or similar technologies. Preferred Qualifications Mongo DB Certified DBA or Developer certification. Mongo DB Atlas Vector Search, time-series collections, Ops Manager, or Cloud Manager experience. Experience with Kafka, Spark, Redis, Elasticsearch, Azure Cosmos DB, and database migrations. Background in Saa S, telemetry, Io T, or large-scale enterprise data platforms.

title: Advanced Software Engr
jobDescription: As an Advanced Software Engineer here at Honeywell, you will lead advanced software development projects, enhance and maintain critical software components, and troubleshoot complex issues. Your expertise will optimize software performance and drive innovation. You will report directly to our Manager and you’ll work out of our Bengaluru, Karnataka location on a Hybrid, work schedule. 6+ years of experience in, Data Engineering & ML OPS, with strong exposure to real-world, production-grade models. Lead development of AI solutions using supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning techniques. Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to translate business requirements into intelligent systems. Optimize model performance, latency, and resource utilization for production-grade deployments. Evaluate and integrate third-party AI services, frameworks, and APIs where appropriate. Strong proficiency in Python and ML libraries (Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Scikit-learn, XGBoost). Experience with NLP, Computer Vision, Time Series Forecasting, and Recommendation Systems. Deep understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques. Hands-on experience with MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Sage Maker, Azure ML). Exposure to LLMs and generative AI frameworks (Hugging Face Transformers, Lang Chain, Open AI APIs). Familiarity with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) and embedding techniques. Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of big data ecosystems (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks) and real-time data streams (Kafka, Flink). Proficiency in SQL and No SQL databases (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Redis). Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and Dev Ops practices for AI/ML workflows. Experience with model interpretability and explainability tools (SHAP, LIME). Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and bias mitigation strategies. Familiarity with edge AI deployment (ONNX, Tensor RT, Coral, NVIDIA Jetson). Exposure to graph-based ML and knowledge graphs. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive delivery in agile environments. Strong problem-solving mindset with a bias toward experimentation and iteration. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to evaluate alternative solutions and articulate technical decisions clearly. Passion for staying current with AI trends, research, and emerging technologies.

jobDescription:
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented product marketing professional with a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and execution excellence. The ideal candidate will be capable of working with cross-functional teams, influencing stakeholders, and driving profitable business growth through effective planning and execution. Candidates should have significant experience in the CCTV industry, with a strong understanding of customer requirements and video surveillance technologies. The role requires the ability to translate customer insights into product concepts, technical requirements, and commercial solutions. The successful candidate will own the entire product lifecycle—from customer discovery and innovation through prototyping, productization, and business scaling. Honeywell Security & Access Solutions (SAS) business is seeking innovative and driven product manager to join its team in Gurgaon or Pune. This role will lead innovation and new product development for the Video portfolio (CCTV & VMS). Key responsibilities include managing the existing product portfolio, defining the product roadmap, identifying customer needs, and developing differentiated solutions that deliver strong customer value and business returns. The position will partner closely with Engineering, Sourcing, and Quality teams to ensure successful and timely product launches, while also driving portfolio positioning, pricing, target market strategy, and sales enablement to achieve revenue and margin objectives. New Product Development • Define & own the Product and Technology roadmap for the portfolio. Have a strong sales & customer connect to analyse customer problems, market needs and technology trends to create on-time, on-cost differentiated offerings that earn significant ROI for the business. • Understand the different needs of target segments and ensure that the portfolio, channel and competency is aligned to win in the market • Carry out Make vs Buy decisions for NPI development. Liaison with Engineering, Sourcing, QA teams to execute NPIs. Meet 100% say/do ratio on all NPIs. Align with Regional & Global counterparts for cross-learning and roadmap alignment. • Integrate inputs to develop distinctive product plans with outstanding financial outcomes; be competent in VOC, research and analysis and basic marketing toolkit [market definition and sizing, segmentation, value management, targeting and positioning, pricing]. This would also include adherence to a detailed Product launch plan and effective launch communication • End to end brand ownership and product lifecycle management (product phase-in/out, etc). Ensure portfolio is always relevant to the market with optimal brand mix to ensure all target segments are served profitably with minimal conflict and cannibalization. Product Competency Building • Drive Product knowledge & Value based sales competency among internal teams (Sales, Marketing & Product Support) and channels (System Integrators, Distributers) through regular, structured trainings • Support Sales team in effectively communicating the value proposition of the portfolio to external ecosystem including System Integrators, Distributers, Consultants and End Users • Keep the team updated on solution offerings and arm them with specification points, differentiators, USPs, comparisons, selectors & other sales tools Marketing Communications • Engage with Marcom team for all new product launches w.r.t. branding, launch plan, events, collaterals, etc to ensure effective communication internally and externally • Coordination with Marcom and Partner Connect team to ensure timely update of Website and e Portals Competition Mapping • Develop strong market network to gather market intelligence and update competition activities on regular basis. Use this knowledge to create means to effectively compete and continuously upgrade the portfolio • Track competition pricing to understand Market Operating prices of products and align our pricing with market on regular basis Personality • Hands on: Ability to work with cross-functional teams, spread across different cities and backgrounds. Shares information and keeps team members and partners informed. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and manage conflict with the team. Builds strong trust based relationship with peers and customers.

minimumQualification: Qualifications/Experience Strong understanding of SAP EHS and regulatory compliance processes Excellent knowledge of the SAP EHS integration with logistics and supply chain 10+ years of IT experience in international corporations, in industries similar to Honeywell, in the area of Health & Safety, Product Safety & Stewardship and Environmental Performance focusing on all existing, new and emerging regulations (GHS, REACH, OSHA, etc.) across key geographies Hands-on experience with S/4HANA EHS configuration Exposure to SAP Product Compliance or Dangerous Goods is a plus Experience conducting requirements analysis, meeting with business owners & users, and performing current state system analysis Experience with SAP Solution Manager, Basis and Security Experience with non-ERP HSEPS solutions like 3E Optimized, 3E ERC+ Prior consulting experience with exposure to clients/customers in US and Europe is an advantage Self-starter, independent thinker and worker, with a positive and can-do attitude Ability to work in a matrix environment Ability to communicate at all levels in the organization, from Team Members to Executives
jobDescription: Sr. IT Analyst – SAP EHS Join a team recognized for leadership, innovation and diversity. The future is what you make it! When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who make the things that make the future Working at Honeywell isn’t just about developing cool things. That’s why our employees enjoy access to dynamic career opportunities across different fields and industries. Are you ready to help us make the future? The Enterprise IT HSEPS team is seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA EHS Consultant to support end-to-end SAP S/4HANA transformation and implementation projects. The consultant will work under the guidance of an EHS Lead or Solution Architect and contribute to configuration, testing, data migration support, and post–go-live stabilization of Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) processes. As a Sr IT Analyst here at Honeywell, you will lead high-impact IT projects, drive data-informed decisions, and enhance operational efficiency. Your expertise will shape our technology roadmap and maintain our competitive edge. Key Responsibilities Lead business sessions to define high level business goals/vision, extract business requirements, define performance indicators and provide solutions for the SAP EHS area Ability to comprehend the technical decisions made for the given business problem to multiple stakeholders such as IT, Leadership, Business, Architects, SMEs and implementation team SAP S/4HANA EHS configuration & support including Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS) and Dangerous Goods Management Support ECC to S/4HANA conversions or greenfield implementations, apply S/4HANA EHS best practices and simplifications. jobDescription:

title: Advanced Cyber Sec Archt/Engr
minimumQualification: Advanced Cyber Security Engineer - AI As a Advanced Cyber Security Engineer here at Honeywell, you will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect our products, critical assets and customer data. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify vulnerabilities, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. You will report directly to our Product Cyber Security Engineering Manager and you’ll work out of our Bangalore Location on a Hybrid work schedule. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, and implement cybersecurity solutions to protect our products and customer data. Develop and integrate Agentic AI workflows with ongoing Product Cyber services and development practices. Directly enable efficient, effective Product Cyber processes through automation and system integration. Collaborate with development and operations teams to integrate product security services into the software development lifecycle and our products. Support product security services that issue millions of product certificates and sign tens of millions of product elements each year. YOU MUST HAVE Overall 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering or related roles and Minimum 2+ years of Software Engineering experience, preferably with a cyber focus, in Java, Groovy, and/or Python. Understanding of common AI usage models with a drive to integrate this into our secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC). Basic knowledge of product security concepts, public key infrastructures, and system integration. Interest in learning new disciplines and then helping others leverage those better. Understanding of SSDLC and DevSecOps practices. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. 2+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering or related roles. Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and their security models. Hands on experience with several of the following: JIRA, ServiceNow, Ubiquity, Jenkins, Claude, GitHub, Software Composition Analysis Tools, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. WE VALUE ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. Learn more

Strong data and analytical skills including Excel is required WE VALUE Knowledge of Planning / Procurement systems and methodologies Strong communication skills and a team player English fluent, any other language is a plus Minimal knowledge of procurement/sourcing/logistic Strong organizational skills and ability to efficiently multi-task, prioritize, and delegate. jobDescription:
Ideation Leader – Fire Portfolio As Fire Ideation Leader you will be responsible for driving innovation, productivity, and value creation across the Fire Portfolio by identifying, developing, and advancing high-impact opportunities that improve profitability, product competitiveness, quality, and supply chain resilience. This role leads the portfolio ideation strategy, manages a pipeline of cost and growth initiatives, and works closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Product Management, and Finance teams to convert ideas into executable projects. As a strategic leader and catalyst for cross-functional collaboration, the Fire Ideation Leader facilitates ideation events, governs opportunity development, drives seedbed creation, and ensures effective progression of opportunities from concept through execution. The role is accountable for maintaining a healthy ideation pipeline, establishing best practices, monitoring portfolio performance, and enabling continuous improvement across the Fire business to deliver measurable business impact and sustainable growth. You will work closely with Fire Portfolio leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to establish long-term innovation strategies, maximize business impact, and deliver measurable results across the portfolio. This position is based in Bangalore and follows a 4/1 hybrid work schedule . The role requires travel to engineering, manufacturing, and customer sites for approximately 10–20% of engagements , typically involving 2–5-day visits and averaging one to three trips per year . As an Advanced Hardware Engineer here at Honeywell, you will design, develop, and implement advanced hardware solutions, working on cutting-edge projects that transform industries. Your expertise will shape future technology and industry solutions. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the Fire Portfolio ideation strategy to identify, prioritize, and convert high-impact opportunities into executable projects. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of productivity, cost reduction, quality, and supply chain improvement initiatives. Facilitate cross-functional ideation events, value engineering workshops, and innovation campaigns across global teams. Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Product Management, and Finance stakeholders to drive opportunity generation and execution. Evaluate product designs, components, materials, manufacturing processes, and emerging technologies to identify value engineering and design-to-cost opportunities. Drive idea qualification, feasibility assessments, risk analysis, business case development, and ROI validation. Provide technical leadership in component engineering, cost optimization, redesign activities, and alternative component qualification. Leverage strong knowledge of electronic hardware design, including analog and digital circuits, power supplies, PCB design, and subsystem integration to assess and develop improvement opportunities. Support component selection, change management, and implementation activities while ensuring compliance with quality, reliability, and regulatory requirements. Coordinate qualification testing, validation plans, and performance assessments to enable successful implementation of approved opportunities. Monitor opportunity conversion, portfolio health, savings realization, and pipeline sufficiency through governance reviews and performance dashboards. Drive alignment and accountability across stakeholders, removing technical and business roadblocks to accelerate project execution. Utilize engineering and PLM tools such as SAP, Teamcenter, Agile, and PDM systems to manage opportunity progression and implementation. Develop and present executive-level reports, business cases, portfolio reviews, and project outcomes to leadership teams. Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and best practice sharing across the Fire Portfolio. Collaborate effectively with global teams and multiple stakeholders. title: Principal AI Engr
minimumQualification: Job Description: Principal AI Leader – Process / Industrial Automation Role Summary The Principal AI Leader will define and execute an AI-first engineering strategy for Process / Industrial Automation, advancing product development, engineering productivity, product intelligence, and enterprise AI adoption. The role will move AI beyond isolated pilots into secure, scalable, governed solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Combining technical leadership, strategic vision, and execution discipline, the successful candidate will modernize traditional engineering practices into an AI-driven operating model. They will partner with engineering, product management, architecture, and business leaders to identify high-value AI opportunities, build scalable solutions, and accelerate adoption across the organization. Key Responsibilities Strategy, Roadmap, and Operating Model: Define the AI vision, maturity roadmap, operating model, investment priorities, and adoption plan for Process / Industrial Automation. AI-Enabled Product Development: Accelerate AI adoption across requirements, architecture, design, coding, testing, DevSecOps, security, documentation, release management, SRE, and operations. AI-Powered Product Capabilities: Partner with product management and engineering to embed AI copilots, conversational AI, predictive analytics, digital twins, autonomous agents, edge AI, knowledge assistants, and industrial AI capabilities into products. Reusable AI Platforms and Frameworks: Establish scalable capabilities such as LLM gateways, RAG platforms, vector databases, prompt libraries, model registries, agent frameworks, AI SDKs, evaluation frameworks, monitoring, and AI marketplaces. Responsible AI, Security, and Governance: Set standards for privacy, security, data governance, prompt governance, explainability, hallucination control, AI audits, compliance, ethics, risk management, and cost governance. Organizational Enablement and Adoption: Build AI capability through evangelists, champions, guilds, communities of practice, internal certifications, hackathons, innovation labs, reusable assets, and adoption programs. Required Qualifications Experience and Domain Depth: 15–20+ years in software engineering, including 8–10+ years in AI/ML, data platforms, industrial automation, or related technology domains. Generative and Agentic AI: 3–5+ years of experience with GenAI and LLMs, plus 2+ years working with agentic AI capabilities. Engineering and Product Expertise: Deep expertise across software engineering, product engineering, AI/ML, and the needs of Process / Industrial Automation products, customer workflows, reliability expectations, and operating environments. Enterprise Transformation Leadership: Proven ability to lead enterprise-scale AI, GenAI, ML, automation, or digital transformation initiatives from strategy through production adoption. Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, product, IT, architecture, cybersecurity, data, legal, operations, finance, and executive leadership. Execution and Outcomes: Strong track record of defining roadmaps, building reusable platforms, leading cross-functional execution, and delivering measurable business outcomes. Technical Skills AI Platform Engineering: LLM gateways, RAG platforms, vector databases, model registries, agent frameworks, AI SDKs, prompt libraries, evaluation frameworks, AI marketplaces, and reusable AI services. Generative AI and Agentic AI: Generative AI, OpenAI, LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic AI, multi-agent systems, MCP, knowledge graphs, conversational AI, and autonomous agents. RAG and Knowledge Systems: RAG architecture, knowledge databases, embeddings, retrieval pipelines, Chroma, pgvector, Pinecone, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, and grounding strategies. AI/ML Engineering and Operations: Machine learning, MLOps, LLMOps, MLflow, LangSmith, model evaluation, model monitoring, AI observability, production AI operations, and lifecycle automation. Cloud AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, cloud-native AI deployment, enterprise integration, scalability, and secure platform operations. Software Engineering and DevSecOps: Cloud-native engineering, containers, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, SRE, secure software development, release automation, enterprise integration, and AI-assisted software delivery. AI Engineering Tools and Developer Productivity: GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, LLM APIs, AI SDKs, prompt testing tools, open code, specKit, GrillMe, token reduction approaches such as RTK or equivalent, and developer workflow automation. Context Engineering and Responsible AI Operations: Context engineering strategies such as .GitHub copilot-instructions or .cursor rules, prompt governance, hallucination control, AI monitoring, responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, and cost governance. Leadership and Business Skills AI Strategy and Transformation: Lead enterprise AI strategy, transformation roadmaps, product thinking, innovation management, and executive communication. Business Impact and Execution: Convert AI opportunities into measurable gains in engineering productivity, product differentiation, customer value, financial performance, and operational efficiency. Drive product-led initiatives from concept through execution, adoption, and measurable impact. Stakeholder Leadership: Engage and influence stakeholders across product, engineering, architecture, Enterprise IT, cybersecurity, data, legal, compliance, operations, finance, and business leadership. Investment, ROI, and Cost Governance: Oversee ROI tracking, vendor management, platform investments, budget planning, licensing, infrastructure optimization, and responsible AI cost governance. Enterprise AI Platforms and Ecosystems: Establish enterprise-grade RAG, LLMOps, and AI governance frameworks. Integrate external agents and MCP servers into enterprise AI workflows and apply NVIDIA technologies and ecosystem capabilities where they strengthen AI solution development. Success Measures Engineering: Higher developer productivity, shorter lead times, increased deployment frequency, lower defect density, improved MTTR, and broader AI-assisted engineering adoption. Create scalable, production-ready AI frameworks and agentic AI capabilities across the engineering lifecycle. Product: Stronger AI feature adoption, higher customer satisfaction, increased feature usage, better prediction and response quality, improved retention, and measurable revenue contribution from AI capabilities. People: Greater AI proficiency, increased certifications, more prompt library contributions, higher training completion, stronger hackathon participation, and greater innovation output. Financial: Reduced engineering costs, improved AI ROI, optimized infrastructure and cloud usage, better license efficiency, and disciplined responsible AI cost management.

jobDescription: As an Application Engineer II, candidate would be responsible for the design, engineering, testing, and commissioning of airport systems, including Airfield Ground Lighting (AGL), Visual Docking Guidance Systems (VDGS), would work closely with project, engineering, and customer teams to deliver reliable, innovative and compliant airport solutions. This role requires hands-on experience in AGL design, proficiency in Auto CAD and EPLAN, and working knowledge of AGL, VDGS and ALCMS/AGL commissioning activities. As an Application Engineer II here at Honeywell, you will provide technical expertise, lead a team of engineers, and deliver high-quality solutions to enhance customer experience and drive business growth. Design and develop AGL and VDGS solutions in accordance with ICAO/FAA/CASA/DGCA CAR standards and project requirements. Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cabinet drawings, loop sensor designs, cable schedules, and technical documentation using Auto CAD and EPLAN. Support integration of AGL, VDGS, CCR and related airport operational systems. Execute FAT, SAT, installation supervision, testing and commissioning activities. Perform troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and commissioning of AGL, VDGS, and CCR systems. Collaborate with project managers, customers, consultants, contractors, and field engineers to ensure successful project execution. Prepare and maintain engineering documentation, as-built drawings, commissioning reports, and technical submittals. Support technical reviews, cost estimation, BOQ preparation, risk assessments, and customer presentations. Ensure compliance with project schedules, quality standards, safety procedures, and airport operational requirements. Travel to customer sites for surveys, design validation, installation support, testing, commissioning, and post-installation support. jobDescription:

title: Sr Controllership Analyst
minimumQualification: YOU MUST HAVE Degree in finance or economics (preferably in the field of accounting) Ongoing or completed ACCA is a plus Minimum 7 Years of experience working as a financial auditor or working as a key contact to external financial auditors within an international matrix organization Fluency (both oral and written) in English. ‘Local language’ (to be adapted per region) is a plus. US-GAAP or IFRS Accounting knowledge required ( experience with independently preparing IFRS-based statutory financial statements including notes preferred) Excellent proficiency in Standard Office Software, experience with standard ERP’s is a plus Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills Initiative, positive attitude, self-starter, “getting-things-done” and “hands-on” attitude.
jobDescription: The Sr. Controllership Analyst is responsible for the preparation of the financial statutory reporting and the completion of the external financial audit for multiple legal entities. The role closely collaborates with the extended team in the Global Finance Center as well as with external service providers. The sr. controllership analyst reports into the Country Controller, located in the region, other key partners are external auditors (incl. tax auditors), other corporate functions and business finance. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ensure Statutory reports are timely and accurately filed for multiple allocated reporting units and legal entities. Derive Statutory Financials per local GAAP or IFRS (depending on the region), based on US-GAAP group reporting Ensuring all of the allocated entities financial transactions and obligations are properly accounted for and correctly reported for statutory reporting purposes based on the relevant accounting standards within the country of operations. Managing internal and external audit requirements, driving the statutory audit to completion in a timely manner. Ensure compliance with local statutory regulations/country requirements on books & record provisions as well as SOX-Compliance Liaising with a variety of stakeholders to ensure deadlines, and standards are maintained Supporting as necessary the Honeywell finance, legal and tax department on implementing and executing strategy and compliance activities. Other accounting and controllership duties as determined by the Corporate Asst. Controller (if applicable) Working with tax consultants for the local tax filings. Support senior management with ad-hoc financial analysis and strategic decision making. As a Sr Controllership Analyst here at Honeywell, you will ensure accurate financial reporting, compliance, and drive financial close processes. Provide insights for strategic decisions and collaborate on process improvements. title: Advanced Cyber Sec Archt/Engr
minimumQualification: Senior Threat Analyst Role Are you passionate about helping to drive global Cybersecurity innovation and change? Do you thrive in environments that encourage critical thinking, creativity, and challenging the status quo? Detection and Response team is looking for a senior analyst for a hybrid role with involvement in Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering. In this role, you will guide identification and analysis of advanced security threats through proactive threat hunting and monitoring of network activity. You will leverage your expertise in detection engineering, particularly within Splunk ES, to design and implement effective detection rules, that will help identify and defend the company infrastructure against cyber threat actors. This position allows deep insight into various aspects of cyber security and will require attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and strong communication skills. Duties and Responsibilities Lead the identification and analysis of sophisticated security threats using advanced tools and methods, including Splunk ES. Conduct proactive threat hunting activities, developing and executing hypotheses to uncover potential security breaches. Design, implement, and optimize detection rules and alerts within Splunk ES and other security platforms to enhance threat visibility. Perform comprehensive emerging vulnerability assessments and recommend effective mitigation strategies to strengthen the organization's security posture. Mentor junior analysts, providing guidance and training on threat hunting methodologies, detection engineering, and the use of security tools. Collaborate with various global teams, including incident response, security operations, and engineering, to integrate threat intelligence into security processes. Stay up to date with the latest trends in cybersecurity and threat intelligence, continuously refining strategies and processes to adapt to emerging threats. Constantly optimize work procedures and automate recurring tasks. Develop and update technical documentation and formulate work instructions to address repeating issues. Key Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 4+ years of experience in Information Security. 3+ years of experience in a Threat Hunting or Threat intelligence role. Experience with incident response and digital forensics. Experience with creating and maintaining detections and alerts. Experience with Splunk ES and Microsoft XDR. Good technical knowledge of Windows/Linux operating systems, various types of applications, and networking technologies. Analytical skills in threat, vulnerability, and intrusion detection analysis. Keen understanding of threat vectors as well as exfiltration techniques. Attention to detail. Ability to develop and follow complex work instructions and documentation. Willingness to learn. We value Knowledge of OT cybersecurity landscape. Experience with SOAR Solutions like XSOAR/Demisto. Knowledge in cloud security (Azure, AWS, MS Office 365). Knowledge of Linux operating system. One or more widely recognized certifications from renowned institutions such as GIAC/SANS, ISC/CISSP or Microsoft. Detailed knowledge of Endpoint Detection and Response tools (e.g., Carbon Black or MS Defender ATP). Knowledge of scripting in Python or PowerShell. Understanding of ITIL process, such as Incidents, Change & Problem management. Experience in working in a global, process-driven organization.

title: Sr Finance Manager
jobDescription:
THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE MAKE IT. APAC Finance Leader (PAS – Projects & Automation Solutions)- Sr Finance Manager Reporting to: PA CFO – APAC & India Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia or Pune, India This position will lead the Finance activities for Project & Automation Solutions (“PAS”) Line of Business. This role will partner and support the APAC PAS General Manager in driving financial performance, managing and standardizing key business processes including the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Monthly Business Review (MBR), Financial Analysis and Forecasts and drive results, including working capital reduction, across Asia Pacific via our matrix organisation. This role will also participate in project and productivity reviews and is responsible for ensuring project review compliance. Business Partnering: Provides business partnering to APAC General Manager & cross functional team to drive Growth and ensure to deliver on the financial commitments
- Revenue, Operating Income, Working Capital, Cash Flow. Provide financial guidance to HPS India leadership team for all activities of the business including Strategic analysis, Specific Deal Analysis, Deal Modeling, Contract Reviews and Cost Control . Provides strong finance leadership in CPQs and all commercial and credit decisions during budgetary and firm proposals. Financial Planning & Analysis: Leads the AOP planning process for the LOB in APAC and supports Monthly Business Review. Analyses & interprets key financials including profitability, project backlog, backlog margin, deviations, utilization, billability and recoveries. Be an active influencer and change agent for the sales, inventory operations planning (SIOP) process. Ensure Intense focus on cost productivity and financial discipline t hrough the development of detailed and prudent business plans, the deployment of spend analysis tools, and influence / inspection/validation of these programs New Entity Implementation & Integration: Acts as the focal point for newly acquired entities and ensure seamless integration. Partner with other SBGs & Corporate for initiatives in Malaysia Principal Hub. Customer to Cash (C2C): Monitors & reviews Working Capital for the LOB and partners with the Working Capital team to improve turns, minimize bad debts & support Working Capital improvement initiatives as required to drive C2C efficiency. Internal Controls and Compliance: Ensures strong internal controls are in place, project reviews are adhered, and any project cost overruns are identified early. Perform a formal (documented) quarterly analytic review of the P&L and balance sheet for the LOB , investigating and documenting all unusual trends and fluctuations. Other: Works with other members of the Finance Team and maintains a productive, dynamic and rewarding team environment. Leads process improvement initiatives. Participates in ad hoc projects. Qualification and Technical Abilities: Professionally (CA or CPA) qualified more than 12 years of experience in finance and accounting. Experience in Manufacturing, project & Service Industry is a must Comfortable and experienced at dealing with various functions and global stakeholders. Fluent in verbal English and in written communication. Knowledge of ERP systems, Preferable SAP . Excellent in MS Office tools . Good knowledge of US GAAP , Direct /Indirect Taxes
- Well versed with Project Accounting Skills Persuasive and articulate, able to influence and negotiate with Cross Functional Team . Challenges the status quo and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement Ability to work under strict deadlines and balancing workload demands Good organization / project management, attention to detail & the ability to multi-task, working with timelines Ability to interact effectively at all organization levels and collaborate with other functions. Strong interpersonal skills. Self-starter and self-finisher with high energy level Able to manage complexity and ambiguity. Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status. jobDescription:
Honeywell Process Automation is a leader in providing innovative process automation solutions that enhance operational efficiency and safety across various industries. Our Control and Safety Systems offering is integral to ensuring the reliability and safety of automated processes. We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Product Management Specialist to manage our various standalone controllers that are typically interfaced to Honeywell Experion and third party SCADA systems. Honeywell sells these controllers through direct channels and indirect channels in our Process Automation and Industrial Automation businesses. This role will report to the Director Portfolio Management for Platforms Infrastructure & SCADA Controls. The Senior Product Management Specialist will focus on product strategy, New Product Introductions, (NPI), product lifecycle management, market analysis, and customer focus to ensure our offerings are valued by our customers while driving business growth. Key

Continuously assess and refine the offerings, ensuring alignment with market demands and technological advancements. Product Lifecycle Management: Oversee all phases of the product lifecycle from ideation through development, launch, and retirement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Technology (R&D), sales, verticals, customer marketing, project engineering, service, supply chain, to drive successful product launches. jobDescription:
Purpose of the Job The purpose of the Senior Project Manager (AI Transformation) role is to work together with SBG leaders and AI evangelists in HTCS to implement and adopt AI tools across HTCS, and to lead a structured upskilling initiative that builds a strong AI culture, defines and enables key AI roles, and delivers role-based AI trainings across all job levels. The role partners closely with SBG Engineering leaders, HR leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate the AI transformation roadmap into measurable business outcomes, sustainable operating rhythms, and scaled change adoption. As a Senior Engineer Program Manager at Honeywell, you will lead and manage engineering programs, define project scope and objectives, collaborate with cross-functional teams, develop and implement project plans, monitor project progress, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure successful project outcomes, contributing to operational excellence and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Principal Responsibilities The principal responsibility is to plan, execute, and govern HTCS AI transformation initiatives by contributing in the following areas:
1. Own and manage the HTCS AI Transformation program plan (scope, milestones, budget/benefits, dependencies, risks, and change impacts) and establish the governance cadence (steering committee, workstream reviews, and KPI reporting).
2. Drive implementation and scaled adoption of priority AI tools within HTCS (e.g., copilots, knowledge assistants, automation, analytics/ML solutions), ensuring alignment to business problems, data/security requirements, and user needs.
3. Build and maintain a prioritized AI use-case portfolio with SBG Engineering and HTCS function leaders; define value hypotheses, success metrics, and realization tracking (productivity, quality, cycle time, cost, and user satisfaction).
4. Lead the HTCS AI upskilling program end-to-end: training needs assessment, role-based curricula, learning pathways, communications, learning logistics, completion tracking, and effectiveness measurement.
5. Partner with HR/L&D to define AI capability frameworks and key AI roles across HTCS (e.g., AI Product Owner, Citizen Developer, Prompt Engineer, Data Steward, AI Champion) and embed them into talent processes (hiring, onboarding, performance and career paths).
6. Establish and run change management and communications to build AI culture (campaigns, showcases, communities of practice, office hours, playbooks, adoption toolkits) and drive engagement across all job levels.
7. Coordinate cross-functional readiness for AI deployments (IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Data Privacy, Procurement, Finance) including access models, data governance, responsible AI controls, and operational support models.
8. Develop standard processes and templates for AI use-case intake, evaluation, delivery, and scaling (business case, data assessment, model/tool selection, validation, rollout, and sustainment).
9. Facilitate alignment between HTCS and SBG Engineering leaders on priorities, resourcing, and decision-making; prepare executive-level materials (status, risks, decisions required, benefits realized).
10. Track and report program health and adoption outcomes using dashboards (training completion, active users, usage patterns, NPS, productivity indicators) and drive corrective actions to ensure delivery.
11. Ensure knowledge transfer and long-term sustainment by establishing an AI community network, documenting standards, and enabling function owners to run AI tools and trainings as part of normal operations. jobDescription: As a Lead Mechanical Design Engineer at Honeywell, you will lead and oversee the mechanical design process, ensuring the development of innovative and efficient mechanical solutions for our products and systems. As a Lead Mechanical Design Engineer at Honeywell, you will lead and oversee the mechanical design process, ensuring the development of innovative and efficient mechanical solutions for our products and systems. Provide industry‑leading metallurgical expertise to support reliable unit operation and drive new innovations across the refining, petrochemical, and gas processing industries. As a key member of the Skills Group, you will apply your metallurgy knowledge and leadership to material selection, unit troubleshooting (including failure analysis and materials testing), and the development of new processes and equipment. You will serve as a recognized technical expert within your discipline, and interface directly with global customers and vendors. Partner with industry experts to diagnose and resolve complex metallurgical and corrosion challenges. Lead material selection and corrosion control decisions for new designs, revamps, and operating units. Conduct hands‑on troubleshooting including field inspections, unit walkdowns, and on‑site failure investigations. Perform and interpret failure analyses including metallography, hardness testing, and materials characterization. Support development of new processes and equipment through materials testing and technical evaluation. Contribute to corporate and industry standards through participation in NACE/AMPP, API, and ASME committees. Provide technical mentorship to early‑career engineers and cross‑functional teams. Engage with global customers to deliver technical guidance, troubleshoot issues, and strengthen long‑term relationships. Bachelor's Degree in Metallurgy, Materials Science/Engineering, or related field. 10-15 years minimum experience within the refining, petrochemical, or gas processing or energy industry.

jobDescription:
Technology Service Specialist – CDU/VDU and Hydro-processing (Lead / Principal Chemical engineer) ​ An excellent career opportunity is currently available for a Technology Service Specialist within the UOP Hydroprocessing & Renewables Technology Services Group of the Technical Services department of UOP Honeywell India’s Energy and Sustainability Solution (ESS) business unit located in Gurugram, Haryana. This position plays a key role in completing the transfer of UOP Honeywell’s technology in order to keep UOP-licensed or UOP-designed units operating safely & profitably. There is regular interaction with UOP's external customers. Key responsibilities include: As a Principal Chemical Engineer at Honeywell, you will be responsible for providing technical leadership, expertise, and guidance in the design, development, and implementation of chemical processes and solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive product development and improvement, and ensuring compliance with safety regulations and industry standards. Job Description: ​The Specialist provides technical support for Honeywell UOP Crude Distillation (CDU), Vacuum Distillation (VDU), Crude Desalting systems, and Hydro-processing technologies (Hydrotreating, Hydrocracking, and related processes) to customers across the globe. Our customers are both external (licensee /operating companies, Engineering Procurement & Construction ('EPC') contractors, vendors and consultants) and internal (Field Services, Regional Services, R&D, Engineering, Business groups, and Sales organization). The primary accountability of the position is to complete the transfer of our technology in order to deliver to our customers' UOP Honeywell-licensed or UOP Honeywell-designed units that operate optimally, profitably and safely. To do so, the Specialist will have regular interaction with those external customers, and with other UOP Honeywell personnel involved in technology delivery projects. In addition to customer contact, the position provides interaction with all the UOP Honeywell departments involved with technology delivery, e.g., CSO, R&D, TSE, and Engineering. The interaction with other UOP Honeywell departments provides excellent exposure as well as providing knowledge of accountabilities in other areas. Technology Services is an excellent career position with opportunities to advance to higher grade levels as well as a career path to other departments, e.g. CSO, R&D and Engineering. Fixed Accountabilities: Primary responsibility to evaluate commercial operations, performance monitoring and troubleshooting of UOP’s CDU/VDU and crude desalting operation. In addition, support Hydro processing technologies (Hydro treating, Hydro cracking and renewable process units), and assist customers in achieving their goals. Participate in Research & Development (R&D) technology development and improvement projects, bringing commercial perspectives and key data to the team. Champion changes & improvements in technologies supported via innovation. Serve as the focal point for office-based support of new unit and revamped unit startups from pre-commissioning through guarantee acceptance. Participate in customer meetings. Participate in Engineering review meetings for new units and revamps including Design Basis, PFD, P&ID, MFD, Plot Plans, HAZOP, Model Reviews, and others. Provide both office-based and on-site troubleshooting/startup assistance to commercial units. Prepare and update general operating manuals, process technology manuals, and training materials and present UOP technology training courses both in the US and abroad. Help prepare material for and participate in, Technical Symposia and Sales Meetings. Work with GSC team to review the recommendations for the solution and suggest unit specific constraints to the team. Identify challenges in the field of Hydro-processing & Renewables technology and propose ideas to be competitive in the market. Develop performance solution models and commercialize the same. Basic Candidate

B.E. / B.Tech. degree in Chemical Engineering is required. 15+ years of experience in engineering, field services, process operations or within the refining industry is required. Additional Candidate
